title: Rockstar Dropped a New GTA 6 Trailer: Nightclub, Yacht and a Tactical Team 🎬 #Shorts
description:
Rockstar released "Grand Theft Auto VI - Pre-Load Now" on Nov 10, 2026, as pre-loading opened for everyone who pre-ordered. The 29-second trailer shows Jason and Lucia dancing at a nightclub, Lucia watching a racer do a backflip, music producer Dre'Quan Priest, a yacht named Ships and Giggles and a tactical team moving in on a building at night. The song is "Blood in Your Eyes" by Tove Lo, from Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album. GTA 6 launches Nov 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Source: Rockstar Games (rockstargames.com/videos/55kss26g), coverage by Game'n'Guide and Toy People.
Footage: official Rockstar Games trailer (Pre-Load Now).
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
